policy.selectionBasis: Curated seed of prominent concentrated 13F filers whose quarterly long books are widely followed research inputs. Directory-driven: adding a manager is a data change plus a fresh receipted capture, never a code change. Every CIK is verified at capture time against the SEC submissions record and the filing's own cover page.

knownExclusions.name: Index/custody giants (BlackRock, Vanguard, State Street)
knownExclusions.reason: Multi-thousand-position index books say little about active conviction and would dominate committed source bytes.

knownExclusions.name: Quant multi-managers (Renaissance, Citadel, Millennium, D. E. Shaw, Two Sigma, AQR)
knownExclusions.reason: 13F long-only quarter-end snapshots misrepresent hedged, high-turnover books; including them invites exactly the freshness misreading this product must avoid.
